description: Introductory Post I support the revised CVSD school budget and look forward to voting for it on April 16. I appreciate the difficult decisions the board has made to cut $4 million as well as applying an additional $1 million as revenue from the fund balance, for a total decrease of $5 million compared to the budget that was voted down on Town Meeting Day.I am deeply committed to public education.
